title: CircuitryProfile
description: JSON Schema for Circuitry named profile files (profiles/<name>.yml), consumed by `cof run --profile <name>`.

adapter.description: Run-level default adapter override. Precedence: CLI > profile > orchestration > config.

model.description: Run-level default model override. Precedence: CLI > profile > orchestration > config.

out.description: Default path to write the run's resulting state JSON to (same file the --out flag writes). Precedence: --out flag > profile > (no file written). Resolved the same way --out resolves today (relative to the working directory). Orthogonal to `persistence`: this is a one-shot snapshot of the final state, not a queryable/resumable backend.

inputs.description: Merged into the initial state as a base layer. CLI -e values win over profile inputs.

effects.description: Per-effect overrides, keyed by dotted effect path as it appears in state (e.g. 'summarize' or 'my_dynamic.child').

model.description: Overrides this effect's model at compile time.

provider.description: Overrides this effect's provider at compile time.

enabled.description: false = do not execute this effect for the run; its node is written as {value: null, meta: {disabled: true, ...}}. Disabling a container (dynamic/loop/conditional/reflector) disables its whole subtree.

routing.description: Per-effect complexity-router control. `false` opts this effect out of the router entirely — it always dispatches on the model it would have with routing switched off (its own `model:` if set, else the run default). A non-empty string pins it to the routing band with that name from `runtime.complexity.routing.bands`, bypassing score-based band selection. Precedence: this effect's `model` (above) always beats a pin; a pin always beats the router's own score-based choice. The named band must exist in the run's resolved routing table, or the run fails before any effect dispatches.

persistence.description: Persistence backend selection for this run. Replaces (never merges with) the orchestration/config `runtime.persistence` block. Backend-specific keys (db_path, dsn, uri, database, collection, table, ...) are passed through.

backend.description: Backend name: jsonl-file, sqlite, mongodb, or postgres.

enabled.description: Defaults to true for a profile-supplied block; set false to disable persistence for runs using this profile.

path.description: File path for jsonl-file (also accepted as an alias for sqlite's db_path).
